Mix with the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt.Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.Bake at 180°C.Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and cook the peas.Rest the loaf 10 minutes, then slice.Serve thick slices with mash and peas.Launch day cheeseburgers and crinkle friesBeef patties grilled medium with melted cheddar, lettuce and tomato in toasted buns, ridged chipsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef patties grilled to medium, cheddar melted on, in toasted buns with lettuce, tomato and onion, with crinkle fries.Bake 1kg frozen crinkle-cut fries at 220°C for 25 minutes.Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties a little wider than the buns and season well.Grill on high heat 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium, adding a slice of cheddar for the last minute.Toast 4 burger buns.Spread with mayo and tomato sauce and build with lettuce, sliced tomato, thin onion rings, pickles and the patty.Serve with the fries.SweetsDiner apple pieCinnamon green apples under a lattice crustHow to make it6 green apples50g butter100g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 L vanilla ice creamPeel, core and slice the apples.Cook with butter, sugar and cinnamon until just soft.Cool the filling for 20 minutes.Line a pie dish with pastry, fill and weave a lattice on top.Bake at 190°C.Serve warm with ice cream.DrinksBlack suit espresso martiniVodka, coffee liqueur and strong espresso shaken ice coldHow to make it180ml vodka120ml coffee liqueur200ml strong coffee2 tbsp sugar syrup12 coffee beans1 bag iceChill four martini glasses in the freezer.Make strong espresso or coffee.Cool the coffee for 5 minutes.Shake two drinks at a time with vodka, liqueur, coffee, syrup and ice for 20 seconds.Strain into the glasses and float three coffee beans on the foam.
